title: AED installation in new HDB estates such as Tengah
asked: Dr Choo Pei Ling asked what preparatory steps are needed before AEDs can be installed in newly developed estates such as Tengah, the estimated timeline for AED installation in Tengah and how it compares with other HDB precincts, and what interim measures support emergency preparedness in new estates pending AED deployment.
response: Ms Sim Ann said SCDF needs infrastructural and security works completed before installing AEDs in new estates, including CCTVs nearby to deter AED theft. She said 29 AEDs have been installed in Tengah to date, with 11 more by February 2026, covering about 70% of HDB blocks in Tengah where residents have moved in, and installation will continue in 2026. She added that SCDF organises community emergency preparedness events such as Community Resilience Days and MyNiceHome roadshows with the People's Association and HDB, several of which have been held in Tengah recently. In a supplementary reply, she mentioned the My Responder Plus programme and encouraged the community to work with Community Emergency and Engagement Committees.
